title: NLO PP-0410/0415 LL Flow Interlock Change

fields.latestPosition: Proposal emailed, awaiting reply (27/08 BR). Agreed PCS to remove the interlock as the transmitter is too unreliable (04/09).
fields.nextAction: PTS to flag the transmitter with maintenance; PCS to implement.
fields.why: NLO fines pumps PP-0410/0415 stop on a Low-Low flow interlock. The line runs about 200 m, so stopping the pump when the flow meter fails increases the risk of blockages. Plant feed does not share this interlock.
fields.design:
- Remove interlock from 160-PP-0410: 160-FIT-0410 Fines Pump Discharge Flow Low Low Alarm Healthy
- Remove interlock from 160-PP-0415: 160-FIT-0410 Fines Pump Discharge Flow Low Low Alarm Healthy
- Add to 150-FE-0310 HPGR Circuit Group Interlock: 160-FIT-0410 Fines Pump Discharge Flow Low Low Alarm Healthy
- PLC: PLC605
fields.impact: Fines pumps will no longer stop on low-low flow; a 160-FIT-0410 low-low flow will instead stop the 150-FE-0310 HPGR circuit group.
